Fresh question pages

Quiz mode creates clean pages without printed answer marks. Each choice links to a color coded feedback page.

Check the answer key

Automatic extraction can miss questions, images, or clinical formatting. Review source answers and explanations before sharing a generated quiz.

Compatible PDF feedback

Color feedback works through ordinary PDF links in common readers. It appears after choosing an option on the result page.

Supported formats & conversion details

Quiz mode supports text-based PDF question banks with BMJ OnExamination layout, or structured questions with A–E choices, Answer: and Explanation:. Scanned pages require OCR and are not automatically converted. Embedded clinical images in source questions may not carry into rebuilt quiz pages; inspect those questions before use. Questions without a reliable key must be completed in review. Original-layout mode preserves source PDF pages and their printed answers while adding navigation and forms. Digital signatures do not survive modification. Password-protected PDFs are rejected. DOCX, PPTX, XLSX and images remain available in original-layout mode.
